package.description: Internet of Everything for Efficient Management

en-US.description: Internet of Everything for Efficient Management
en-US.longDescription: SeewoIotManage is a platform that uses the open Seewo IoT protocol to manage various types of devices on campus together and provide basic control capabilities. It helps school device managers manage various devices that could not be managed together before.
en-US.name: 希沃物联校园平台

zh-CN.description: 万物互联 高效管理
zh-CN.longDescription: 希沃物联校园平台是一款通过开放的希沃物联协议，将校园内各品类设备统一管理，并为其赋予基础管控能力，帮助学校设备管理者解决多品类设备无法统一管理问题的平台。
zh-CN.name: 希沃物联校园平台
